design.name: 天狗
design.brief: The Tiangou (天狗) of Yin Mountain in the Shan Hai Jing's Western Mountains, 'shaped like a wildcat with a white head': a lean, fast pack hunter about 1.4 m long and 0.8 m at the shoulder, with a slim wildcat body, long legs, a bushy tail and a big pure WHITE head with a short muzzle, pointed ears and a white mane-like ruff; the body fur is dark slate grey with rusty red legs. A jagged magenta-violet thunder rune glows on its white forehead (weak spot); violet glowing eyes; lightning veins along the spine. Main pose: howling with the head thrown back. Sly and quick. NOT a wolf, NOT a fox: a white-headed wildcat-like beast.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a big dog (quadruped), the body level, the four legs straight under the body and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air between them and between left and right legs; the head held level facing straight ahead with the mouth closed; the big bushy tail extending straight back and slightly upward (not curled); the white mane ruff and the magenta lightning veins painted opaque (no halo); MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding fur, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; the fur along its spine is plain dark grey fur (NOT magenta spikes)
design.turnaround_digits: each paw with four separate toes, countable; the ears and the whole tail fully inside the frame; in the side views the whole body and tail must fit inside the view with margin.
